_modelNote: Moved from claude-sonnet-4-6 ($3/$15) on September 30 2026. Newer and a third cheaper at the same tier. The model string lives in suggest-anthropic.js; this entry only prices it, so the two have to be changed together or the spend reads wrong with nothing reporting it.
_cacheNote: Prompt-cache multipliers on the input rate: a write costs 1.25x (5-minute TTL), a read 0.1x. Only the response-generation call is cached.
_speechNote: Per-service speech rates, looked up by service name: '<id>SttCostPerHour' and '<id>TtsCostPer1kChars'. A service missing from here is priced at zero, which reads visibly wrong; that is deliberate, because the previous arrangement priced an unknown service at Deepgram's rate and named it Deepgram. List prices, and the estimate ignores every free allowance, so a light user owes less than it says. Nobody wins both halves: the cheapest to speak with is not the cheapest to listen with.
_elevenlabsNote: Corrected September 30 2026 from 0.40 / 0.10, which were credit-bundle estimates and were high. Both are now published per-unit rates read off elevenlabs.io/pricing/api, and both are the rate for the model this app actually asks for: Scribe v2 batch transcription at $0.22 an hour (NOT the $0.39 realtime rate - the app submits a finished phrase rather than streaming), and Multilingual v2 speech at $0.08 per 1k characters, which is the same rate as their v3 voice. Flash and Turbo voices are $0.04 if the app ever offers them. A sale was running on the v4 voices until October 12 2026; these are the regular rates and are the right ones to keep.
_estimatedRates: ONE of these is an estimate rather than a published per-unit price, and is marked so it is not quoted as measured: OpenAI bills speech by token, not by character, so its speaking rate is derived. Everything else here is a published rate.
